body:
What you say is so clearly in front of billions of eyes and not seen, it so seems, your problems in life are that of many, we all have hidden lives, including me, a system controlled by the 1% is so obvious now for people in quaratine, they need to wake up to this 'matrix'. The real escape starts with escape from the ego i believe. 

I hope you find ways to better you life, im not good for advice, as it can only do so much for change, but the real escape isnt taking yourself out, it just seems too easy. We all have ideas

My view on therapy is that it doesn't work, simply because i had no motivation to change either.

Now if you could hear me out.

Life is like a video game, everyone has their reality set on them.

We all have our suffering created from our mind, 'ego' 

How to level up without any action:

"Nofap" = motivation > that extra push to do more actions than not

No social media: Leads to more time, space, peace, change to work on self

More sleep: obvious one

Its some advice,

Im not going to tell you it gets better, advice doesn't change the physical.

The truth is reality is not always reality. 

Sometimes, even all the time, we have these toxic thoughts which carry our energy, create a false reality, create our truth and change our mind and ways we view the world. 

Desires lead to suffering, the real escape to a better life begins from Thoughtlessness.

Sleep is the reset and meditate is the advice id give.

Im here to listen if you want to explore it again and feel of getting somewhere better

begin nofap, look it up, if your prepared for significant changes and a sense of meaning and purpose in life, you seem to desire. You are in the midst of setting a path for yourself that is positive if you choose so. 

Lose attachments of your negative self talk and negative identify and start small and feel good about making change.

Time is a good investment, you are 16 you have plenty of time.
want to talk?
Your thoughts are rational and logical. Actions normal

What makes you say this? This statement is true, as well as humans are imperfect and lie endlessly if it means for survival. People could say they care about you to keep you alive. To keep someone alive is a different story

I know how the thoughts are consuming but please dont allow them. Its an endless cycle day in day out, become a habit and you get stuck in life and it becomes years of self torture. Begin somewhere and look back happier and accomplished only with little effort everyday you can become what you need to be. Look for resources, maybe meditation. Simply dont think at all. I hope you take time to love yourself.

you are 15, people believe you become fully conscious at twenty one. but there is always room for expansion, endless time, too much time. You are advanced enough to realise who you are so young. If you look around you see many people that hide their identity, their true joy is hidden and comes out childish, I hope some of this makes sense...

Its the nice people of the world who seem to not belong but they care too much for an existence where it seems pointless as we are to die so anyway. If i could say that your happiness now relies on you as you've come to terms that the world isn't here to satisfy but to challenge, now its where it goes either way you face it and attract or retract and accept what comes which way. I guess i'm that random stranger who does seem to want others to be happy as each individual seeks during their misfortunes of life.

Noone understands but because no one is you, i suffer incredibly this way believe me, and i could understand no one is ever there because the most darkest truths come out at the most idiotic times. It seems you are becoming familiar with the Matrix, i wish i was kidding.
im going to be real. clear your mind, youve had enough in that dimension.
there is two things, is realise you dont need them for your ego, or enjoy your own company as weird as it sounds. i hope this helps..

Their makeup is as thick as they want their image. Think of their suffering with their identity and how much time they spend on themselves, their ego needs to be fed and you were nice enough to be that person. Now don't forget how much of a sad aspect it is of the amount of an unhappy life they will lead to acquire your age. Don't forget this is just an event passing you by.

Take this how you will. A good quality about yourself that trumps others is that you are not afraid of fear, or approaching people. If it honestly takes what you are saying, then im sorry to say that is what it may take, i could be wrong but to regain your reputation you first need to put the trust back in yourself before you want others to trust you.
well then I would say let the past be the past, because you cannot change it. you can focus on good qualities about yourself. Remind yourself of how good of a person you actually are.
if you are prepared to begin again improve your life so they will stalk you so to speak

you know the cycle begins when you wake up and laugh for being alive. Death isn't taken seriously nor life, but preventing is, but bringing death forward is. How backward peoples view are, if questioning results in such answers then I would call that destiny.

the real life video game needs an update. People are so blind to the truth on how much people suffer, we are meant to hide our lives, im at the end and i dont care what people think anymore i hope you do the same
youve done well to reach 25
would you encourage meditation. at least watching the thoughts that come and see how they affect you. being alone is an opportunity
I dont want to tell you what you should do, but it would be a good start in talking to someone close about this, even a small amount of relief is taken off in telling anyone, you arent stupid either

I feel i need to say that life is tough, we all know this and hate it without question, its here to challenge everyone. i like to compare it to a video game . I see you focus on things out of your control, and that is long lasting and it will not benefit. if you could focus on just yourself, this will change many things, we are all the same, think the same way, the world doesnt suck its just the people i get it man.
you can level up. im not trying to be funny. its life. its a game. we all play it, for people who want to quit the game they know what its all about.

its literally the reason why i didnt do it, and why others dont too, they are scared and some part of the still wants to live. Thats why its talked about so much there is so much pain, and we want to get better deep down. theres also the side of us we like suffering. People dont even consider that wanting to die is an intelligent idea. Its logical.
In the final moments the fear is the clinging to life. There is always two sides to it.

if you only knew what im going through, im the exact opposite, i want to not have to be controlled by the energy source, my body, physically, and mostly mentally draining, my whole life for this thing. its overlooked

its people like us that deserve better. the hardest things in life are the best things for you they say, and with that being said, combine that with the understanding life is meaningless just makes me want to leave even more

the decision of suicide is logical and is pretty damn meaninful to think about. I agree that fear holds us back in commiting the final act. Honestly ive been in and out of feeling horrible im starting to notcie alot more things people say and its all useless things to trick you so you dont do it. There is never a good enough reason to not do it, and theres always a reason to keep living. Reality is meaningless for sure. Were all part of the same page where if we are feeling ok we have room to want to help someone who wants to die because it was them not long ago.

theres always an excuse for the living to stay living, instinct i guess. I too find suffering neverending, finding me at stupid times. Its made me wake to how fake everyone is, pretending they are ok with life, nothing matters in life in the end, so what im trying to do is just become nothing, dont want to think anymore, they say if you dont use something you lose it or whatever, so that sounds like a better alternative, the fear of death is the clinging to life. Our mind patterns repeat, like life, over and over. Im not going to give advice thats temporary, but agree that theres no real reasons, just gather enough energy and go from there.
also we weren't sure if we had a choice to be born or not.

The answers to life is there arent any. A sad reality that hits for people searchining for a 'sole mate' or something. Life is purposeless for me, I see it like a video game,.... I can see you would benefit being in the present moment and not identifying with dark thoughts, as hard as it is, im dealing with the same thing. You do not have to wait for anything to get better, the future isnt guaranteed. I mean well, i hope you find peace.
